zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機22架次出海 16架次逾越海峽中線
zh.summary: 國防部指出，自2026年7月30日上午7時24分起，陸續偵獲中共殲11、殲16、轟6及空警500等各型主輔戰機與無人機共22架次出海，其中16架次逾越海峽中線及其延伸線，進入台灣北部、中部、西南及東部空域，並配合共艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」。國軍已運用聯合情監偵手段掌握，並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統應處。
body: 國防部於2026年7月30日下午發布新聞稿表示，自當日上午7時24分起，陸續偵獲中共殲11、殲16、轟6、空警500等各型主戰機、輔戰機及無人機計22架次出海。其中，共有16架次逾越海峽中線及其延伸線，進入台灣北部、中部、西南及東部空域。
國防部指出，中共軍機配合共艦，假所謂「聯合戰備警巡」之名，對台灣周邊空域及海域進行騷擾。對此，國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握，並檢派任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統適切應處。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 22 PRC Aircraft Near Island with 16 Crossing Strait Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated that from 07:24 AM on July 30, 2026, it detected 22 PRC military aircraft, including J-11, J-16, H-6, and KJ-500 fighters, support aircraft, and drones. Among them, 16 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and its extension, entering airspace off northern, central, southwestern, and eastern Taiwan. According to the ministry, the aircraft operated alongside naval vessels in a so-called joint combat readiness patrol. In response, Taiwan's armed forces monitored the situation using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance systems, and dispatched aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on the afternoon of July 30, 2026, that starting from 07:24 AM, it had detected 22 sorties of PRC military aircraft operating at sea. The aircraft detected included J-11, J-16, H-6, and KJ-500 fighters and support aircraft, as well as drones. Among these, 16 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and its extension, entering airspace off northern, central, southwestern, and eastern Taiwan.

The ministry stated that the PRC aircraft operated in coordination with PRC naval vessels under the pretext of a so-called joint combat readiness patrol to conduct activities in the airspace and waters surrounding Taiwan. In response, Taiwan's armed forces monitored the situation using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance assets, and deployed response aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to handle the situation appropriately.

zh.title: 波音777-9測試機隊時數達4800小時 第7架將進行ETOPS認證
zh.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，波音777-9型客機測試機隊的累計測試飛行時間已達到4800小時。同時，一架剛出廠的第7架測試機體將加入機隊，並負責執行雙發延程飛行（ETOPS）認證相關測試，持續推進該機型的驗證程序。
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，波音777-9型客機測試機隊的測試飛行總時間已正式達到4800小時。相關測試數據記錄了該型雙引擎客機在認證過程中的持續飛行進展。
報導指出，一架剛出廠的全新飛機正加入這支持續擴大中的測試機隊。作為該計畫中的第7架機體，該架飛機後續將負責執行雙發延程飛行（ETOPS）認證相關任務。
隨著第7架機體的投入，該測試機隊將執行專門的ETOPS認證測試，以在先前累積的4800小時飛行測試基礎上，繼續完成波音777-9的後續認證程序。
作為這項進度的背景，波音於7月28日表示，777X計畫已獲美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）批准，在型別檢驗授權（Type Inspection Authorization）4B下展開認證試飛，並持續預期於2027年首次交付。

en.title: Boeing 777-9 Test Fleet Reaches 4,800 Hours as 7th Aircraft Prepares for ETOPS Certification
en.summary: According to report material from Simple Flying, the Boeing 777-9 test aircraft fleet has successfully accumulated a total of 4,800 test flight hours during its ongoing flight testing activities. In addition, a newly built seventh airframe is joining the expanding test fleet of the twinjet aircraft type. This factory-fresh seventh aircraft will be assigned to carry out upcoming Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) certification testing as part of the overall certification program for the Boeing 777-9.
body: According to Simple Flying, the Boeing 777-9 test flight fleet has reached a cumulative total of 4,800 test hours during its evaluation program. The milestone reflects ongoing flight test activities conducted across the existing fleet of the twinjet aircraft model.

Furthermore, a factory-fresh airplane is joining the growing fleet of twinjets. As the seventh airframe in the test lineup, this newly completed aircraft will be tasked with conducting Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) certification procedures.

The introduction of the seventh airframe specifically for ETOPS certification marks a further step in the flight testing phase, adding to the 4,800 test hours already logged by the Boeing 777-9 test fleet.

As programme background, Boeing said on July 28 that the 777X had received FAA approval to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, while the company continued to anticipate first delivery in 2027.

zh.title: AeroVironment展示Mayhem 10無人機蜂群協同作戰能力
zh.summary: AeroVironment與Applied Intuition於2026年7月29日宣布達成戰略合作協議，將Acuity ISR/Strike自主軟體整合至Mayhem 10發射效果系統。雙方近期已完成現場技術演示，展示由單一操作員監督多架Mayhem 10無人飛行載具同步動作並執行蜂群協同作業，該項技術開發主要用於支援美國陸軍的發射效果計畫需求。
body: 無人機製造商 AeroVironment 與自主軟體開發商 Applied Intuition 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日宣布達成戰略合作協議，將 Applied Intuition 的 Acuity ISR/Strike 自主控制軟體整合至 AeroVironment 的 Mayhem 10 發射效果系統。這項技術整合旨在讓多架 Mayhem 10 無人飛行載具能夠共享目標定位資訊，並在威脅環境發生變化時即時調整行動，以執行尋找、追蹤與打擊目標的協同作戰任務。
AeroVironment 表示，兩家公司近期已完成一項技術演示，多架 Mayhem 10 系統成功同步飛行動作並以蜂群模式運作，同時適應不同的威脅情境。在該控制架構下，整組蜂群無人機由單一操作員進行全域監督，無須讓操作員在整個任務期間對每架無人機進行單獨且直接的手動操控。此項成果是在多個地點進行了數個月的軟硬體系統整合工作後所取得。
這項合作計畫主要支援美國陸軍的「發射效果」計畫。該計畫旨在採購並部署可從有人或無人平台發射的小型無人飛行載具，以擴展軍方在戰場上的偵察監視、目標定位、電子戰以及精準打擊能力。此外，AeroVironment 指出 Mayhem 10 可以在遭遇 GPS 干擾、欺騙及通訊受阻的惡劣環境下持續執行任務。
Mayhem 10 由 AeroVironment 於 2026 年 4 月首度推出，是一款具備模組化設計的無人機，能夠從空中、陸地及海上等多元平台進行發射。該機型採用開放式架構設計，允許第三方廠商在不重新設計整套系統的情況下新增自主軟體與任務酬載。其模組化酬載艙可支援情報偵察、電子防護、通訊中繼、誘餌及精準打擊武器。
在性能規格方面，Mayhem 10 最大可攜帶 10 磅的任務裝備，作戰航程超過 100 公里（約 62 英里）。根據 AeroVironment 公布的資料，該機款續航時間超過 50 分鐘，巡航速度為每小時 80 英里，最高衝刺速度可達每小時 120 英里，且操作人員可在不到 5 分鐘的時間內完成組裝並發射升空。

en.title: AeroVironment and Applied Intuition Demonstrate Mayhem 10 Drone Swarm Autonomy
en.summary: AeroVironment and Applied Intuition announced a strategic teaming agreement on July 29, 2026, to integrate Acuity ISR/Strike autonomy software with the Mayhem 10 launched-effects system. The companies completed a flight demonstration showing multiple Mayhem 10 uncrewed aircraft operating as a coordinated swarm under the supervision of a single operator. The joint effort supports the US Army Launched Effects program, which aims to deploy small uncrewed aerial systems from various platforms for surveillance, targeting, and strike operations.
body: AeroVironment and Applied Intuition announced a strategic teaming agreement on July 29, 2026, to integrate Applied Intuition's Acuity ISR/Strike autonomy software with AeroVironment's Mayhem 10 launched-effects system. According to the companies, the combined technology allows multiple Mayhem 10 uncrewed aircraft to share real-time targeting information, adapt their operational actions as threats change, and work together in collaborative hunter-killer operations to find, track, and engage targets.

AeroVironment reported that the companies recently completed a successful demonstration in which several Mayhem 10 systems synchronized their movements, operated as a coordinated swarm, and adapted to different threat environments. Under this autonomy architecture, a single operator supervises the entire swarm of aircraft rather than directly controlling each vehicle individually throughout the flight mission. The demonstration followed several months of technical integration work carried out at multiple locations.

The joint work supports the US Army's Launched Effects program, which seeks small uncrewed aircraft that can deploy from crewed or uncrewed platforms to extend surveillance, targeting, electronic warfare, and strike capabilities. The Mayhem 10 is designed to operate in challenging environment conditions, including areas affected by GPS jamming, spoofing, and degraded communications.

AeroVironment originally introduced the Mayhem 10 in April 2026 as a modular aircraft capable of launching from air, ground, and maritime platforms. The uncrewed aircraft features an interchangeable payload section supporting intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance equipment, electronic warfare systems, communications relays, decoys, or precision-strike weapons.

The aircraft can carry up to 10 pounds of mission equipment and operates at ranges exceeding 100 kilometers, or approximately 62 miles. AeroVironment lists the aircraft with an endurance of more than 50 minutes, a cruise speed of 80 mph, and a dash speed of 120 mph, with operational crews capable of assembling and launching the vehicle in less than five minutes.

zh.title: 2026上半年全球商務航空起降成長4.2% 持分共享飛行為主要動能
zh.summary: 根據ARGUS International數據，2026年上半年全球商務航空活動年增4.2%，總起降次數達244萬次。北美市場佔全球總量65%，其中持分共享營運年增11.7%，成為推動成長的主要力量。此外，歐洲市場起降量年增1.6%，佔全球逾14%。
body: 根據ARGUS International發布的最新統計數據，2026年1月至6月期間，全球商務航空活動展現持續成長趨勢，總計完成244萬次起降，較2025年同期成長4.2%。在今年上半年的前六個月中，全球商務航空的單月起降活動均呈現穩定增長。
北美地區持續作為全球商務航空的營運核心，佔全球總起降架次高達65%。該區域在今年上半年共錄得177萬次航班，較2025年同期成長3.5%，創下過去四年來的同期新高紀錄，同時比疫情前的2019年上半年高出15.4%。在北美各類營運型態中，持分共享營運成長最為迅猛，年增11.7%，增加38,808架次航班；包機活動年增3.1%；私人飛行則微增0.3%，但仍以42.9%的占比維持當地最大營運類別。
在ARGUS追蹤的四種主要機型類別中，有三類錄得成長。其中輕型噴射機成長6.1%，為表現最佳的機型類別；渦輪螺旋槳飛機成長4.3%，中型噴射機成長3.2%。大型客艙噴射機則為唯一衰退的類別，較去年同期下降1.8%。此外，歐洲作為全球第二大商務航空市場，上半年起降次數增長1.6%，佔全球總量的14%以上；加拿大則以4.8%的全球占比位居單一國家第二名。
統計數據亦顯示，星期四為商務航空最忙碌的營運日，上半年平均每日錄得11,201架次航班；星期六則為最不忙碌的營運日，平均僅7,545架次。ARGUS預測，2026年下半年北美商務航空活動將再成長2.2%。不過該機構同時警告，燃油價格上漲、地緣政治不確定性以及大型客艙噴射機活動的疲軟，可能成為今年剩餘時間市場發展的潛在風險因子。

en.title: Global Business Aviation Activity Rises 4.2% in First Half of 2026, ARGUS Data Shows
en.summary: Global business aviation activity increased by 4.2% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, recording 2.44 million departures worldwide, according to data from ARGUS International. North America remained the largest market with 1.77 million flights, representing 65% of global activity, driven by an 11.7% surge in fractional operations. Europe accounted for slightly over 14% of global departures with a 1.6% increase. Among aircraft classes, light jets posted the strongest growth at 6.1%.
body: Global business aviation activity expanded by 4.2% year-over-year during the first half of 2026, recording a total of 2.44 million departures worldwide from January through June, according to new data published by ARGUS International. Flight departures registered monthly increases in each of the first six months of the year.

North America maintained its position as the global hub for business aviation, accounting for 65% of all worldwide departures. Operators completed 1.77 million flights in the region during the six-month period, marking a 3.5% increase compared with the first half of 2025 and representing the highest first-half volume recorded in the past four years. This performance also exceeded the activity level of the first half of 2019 by 15.4%.

Fractional operations drove the strongest growth in North America, rising 11.7% and adding 38,808 flights year-over-year. Charter operations increased by 3.1%, while private flying edged up 0.3%. Private operations remained the largest single operational segment, representing 42.9% of total North American flight activity. Across aircraft categories, light jets led gains with a 6.1% increase, followed by turboprops up 4.3% and midsize jets up 3.2%. Large-cabin jets were the sole category to decline, falling 1.8%.

Europe, the second-largest market globally, registered a 1.6% rise in flight activity during the first half, accounting for slightly more than 14% of global departures. ARGUS forecasts North American business aviation activity to grow by an additional 2.2% in the second half of 2026, though it noted rising jet fuel prices, geopolitical uncertainty, and weakness in large-cabin jet activity as potential risk factors.
